summary: Iteration 2 tested the new deal detail page (Pagina Affare) and ran a quick regression. Backend: 27/27 pytest pass. That is 9 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_deal_detail.py plus the 18 from iteration 1. The new tests cover: GET /deals/{id} structure, the panoramica fields and the labels list; 404 for an unknown deal and 401 without a token; PATCH of etichetta/data_prevista/valore/prodotti, which logs 'Affare modificato: <fields>' with deal_id, and a PATCH that changes nothing logs nothing; fase_prev is set on Aggiudicato, kept on Aggiudicato->Perso, and reopening to fase_prev gives status open; contratti webhook proposta_inviata/remind_inviato on a won deal is ignored and returns ignored='affare già chiuso', while 'perso' still applies; a note on the deal shows on both the deal and the person; an activity with deal_id shows in the deal's activities; deleting a person deletes their deals (GET returns 404). Frontend, signed in through a Clerk ticket as Angelo (admin) and Luca (commerciale), all requested flows work. Header: title, owner, IN CORSO/AGGIUDICATO/PERSO badge, Aggiudicato/Perso buttons, Riapri when closed (returns to fase_prev), Crea proposta, admin-only delete (hidden for Luca). Clicking a stage chevron changes fase and shows the '0g ·' counter. Riepilogo edit (titolo, valore, etichetta Molto probabile/Ci pensa, data prevista) persists after reload; the owner select is hidden for a commerciale who does not own the deal. Prodotti checklist adds 2 products and the button changes to 'Modifica prodotti'. Dettagli shows the aggiudicazione/chiusura dates after winning. The Persona link opens the person page. Panoramica renders. A note saved on the deal appears in the deal timeline and the person timeline. The Attività tab preselects the deal; a saved activity appears in 'Nell'occhio del mirino' and on the person. Navigation to the deal page works from the kanban card, the list row (deal-row-<id>), person-deal-link-<id> and global search; an unknown id redirects to /affari. Crea proposta prefills rows from the deal products, the preview shows Italian formatting (€ 360,00, 05/11/2026), and 'Crea e invia' opens the proposal sheet. The proposal then appears in Proposte (PR-2026-0013 INVIATA), the fase becomes Proposta inviata and the valore is synced to 650 €. Person detail page regression: OK. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Accepts an empty titolo ({"titolo": ""} returns 200 and the deal has a blank title). POST validates titolo; PATCH does not. The frontend Riepilogo edit also allows saving an empty title.
History text 'Proposta PR-... creata da X · € 650.00' uses non-Italian number format (should be € 650,00).
Only activities are unlinked; notes/history with that deal_id and mock_proposte stay orphaned.

ui_bugs.issue: save() always calls setEdit(false). patch() swallows errors with a toast, so on API failure the form closes and the user's edits are lost.

issues: fmtMoney (it-IT, maximumFractionDigits 0) shows '1250 €' with no thousands separator, because the it-IT locale only groups numbers of 5+ digits by default. Add useGrouping: 'always' to get '1.250 €'.
The bottom-right toast covers the simulate buttons in the ProposalPanel sheet (Pagamento ricevuto / Cliente rifiuta) for a few seconds.
Native date inputs are still used: deal-edit-data-prevista, activity date/time, proposal scadenza.

action_items: Validate a non-empty titolo in PATCH /deals/{id}, and in the Riepilogo edit form
Keep the Summary edit form open when the PATCH fails
Optional: use Italian formatting in the 'Proposta creata' history text; set useGrouping 'always' in fmtMoney; clean up notes/history/proposals when a deal is deleted
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1519 lines. Split it into routers (deals, persons, activities, webhooks, contratti, import).
apply_contratti_event finds the deal by the 'proposte' array for log events but by 'proposta_id' for fase events. This works today because both fields are written, but it is inconsistent.
DealDetail load() fires 2 requests with no error handling for /contratti/stato. If it fails, mode stays 'esempio' and the error is silent.
test_credentials: Per /app/memory/test_credentials.md: angelo+clerk_test (admin), luca+clerk_test (commerciale). Tokens via tests/make_test_users.py; UI ticket via tests/make_ticket.py <Name>.
seed_data_creation: UI seed via `python tests/make_ui_deal.py` (TEST_UI person + deal). It was deleted after the run (cascade). No TEST_ deals remain. New mock proposal PR-2026-0013 remains in mock_proposte.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python tests/make_test_users.py && python -m pytest tests/test_deal_detail.py tests/test_crm_api.py -n 0`. For UI: `python tests/make_ui_deal.py` gives pid/did, then `python tests/make_ticket.py Angelo` and open /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t>. Tickets are single-use. Not tested: drag&drop on the kanban in this iteration, ProposalPanel actions from the deal page beyond opening, the OrgDetail page.
